spawn playwright test on 127.0.0.1:3123 at IDLE priority

write only under index.html/test-results/stage3 and test-results/stage3-artifacts and the LOCALAPPDATA idle-sensor cache
forbidden: EncodedCommand (base64 -EncodedCommand is not used and must not be reintroduced)
writes outside test-results/stage3, test-results/stage3-artifacts and the LOCALAPPDATA idle-sensor cache
killing node.exe by name (only its own tree and a recognised `next start` on :3123)
